notes: «وغير، واحد» names no one: it is an unnamed transmitter in the first level
«عن أمه، حميضة بنت ياسر» and «عن جدتها، يسيرة» : the relation word and its name are one link named by the name alone (rule 7, applied to «أمه» by analogy)
«قالت قال لنا رسول الله» : يسيرة is the last link and relays the saying
«هانئ بن عثمان» is occurrence 1; the later mention in the compiler's remark is not chain
